title: Hays County new Poaceae candidate species ID cards — review-only
method: All 58 iNaturalist Hays names were reconciled to one existing alias plus 57 staged candidate taxa. Card fields modeled after the 112 live Grass ID Lab species data format, but deliberately without unverified traits or third-party image bytes.

merge_guards.reason: Species-level diagnostic characters remain unproven for most candidates. Importing unknown traits and empty galleries into the live visual key would mislead field users. Species review/permissions required.

taxa.field_rule: Observed Hays photographs: Open to somewhat loose grass panicle with flattened-looking elongated hanging spikelets; green grassy stand and culm close-ups visible. Confirmation still required: One spikelet in profile with mm scale, separable keeled glumes and lemmas, awn/apical teeth, leaf sheath hairs and ligule.
